messages:
alicia: rolled cilium 1.21.2 to west2-gpu this morning, noticed a spike in pod restarts and RDMA jobs timing out around 09:10 UTC
ben: saw similar in canary at 08:50 — traffic between gpu pods dropping, app-level timeouts.
chao: logs show a lot of conn reset on sidecars, and dmesg mtu warnings on node02: 
chao: ```kernel: xfrm: ERROR: skb->len > mtu? frag failed```
ryan: any recent MTU changes? we didn't touch calico or host MTU.
alicia: no MTU changes. only change was Cilium 1.21.1 -> 1.21.2 (daemonset + operator).
ben: tcpdump on node02 shows bursts of retransmits and then flows pinning to different veth NICs. looks like conn hashing regressed.
infra-bot: deploy/daemonset/cilium upgraded by alicia at 1768804200 - status: completed :white_check_mark:
sara: can you paste the `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide` for affected nodes?
alicia: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide | grep cilium
cilium-operator-6f8d9    1/1 Running   0  2h   10.0.2.12  node01
cilium-7k2lp              1/1 Running   0  2h   10.0.2.13  node02
cilium-9z4mq              0/1 CrashLoop 5  1h   10.0.2.14  node03
```
chao: node03 is where most GPU pods got stuck. kernel logs show `rdma_cm: refused connection` intermittently.
ben: hypothesis: cilium datapath change to conntrack/ct-helper altered flow pinning which breaks SR-IOV/RDMA fastpath.
ryan: workarounds? can we toggle cilium's `enable-ceph-kmod` (no) or revert to 1.21.1?
alicia: rolling back to 1.21.1 on node03 now, will watch.
ben: NPTL: try disabling conntrack on the policy for RDMA namespaces: `ct.max_entries=0`? risky.
sara: for immediate mitigation, draining node03 and moving GPU jobs to healthy nodes is reducing tail latency.
chao: also reproduced locally in staging with `minikube` + SR-IOV passthrough: upgrade causes `ibv_post_send` errors when flows rebalance.
infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0412 (cilium datapath regression impacting RDMA/GPU pods) by ben.
ben: action items: 1) rollback cluster to 1.21.1 for west2-gpu (alicia owner) 2) run bisection on cilium commits between x->y (chao) 3) notify affected customers + schedule maintenance (ryan/sara) 4) open bug with cilium w/ packet captures and kernel logs (ben)
alicia: rollback complete on node03 at 1768804986, pods recovering but still seeing intermittent packet drops for ~2-3 minutes post-rollback.
chao: uploaded pcaps and kube-proxy conntrack dumps to the incident thread: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0412/pcaps
ryan: FYI, schedulers show GPU utilization spiking due to retries; we might hit capacity limits if this persists. let's set autoscale buffer +10% on gpu-pool.
sara: doing customer comms draft now. cc: legal for regulated customers.
ben: next steps: run synthetic east-west test (grpc stream passthrough) against canary, measure P99, packet loss, and RDMA ops before re-upgrade. chao, can you script that?
chao: on it. will push a small harness to infra/playbooks and tag `@eng-ml` for RDMA validation.
alicia: thanks team. if we get clean bisection, we can also try a targeted config change rather than full revert.
ryan: please keep updates here. if anyone sees an unexplained drop, ping `#oncall` and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
